name: ecommerce-invoices-and-documents-livewire
description: Two Livewire components for the person a document was issued to: a list of their documents filed under the numbers the documents carry, and one document rendered entirely from what it froze at issue.
features: Every value rendered comes from the document's own frozen rows, so no template traverses a relation into the catalogue or the customer
A document renders identically with the sale seam unbound, which is the whole claim the freeze makes
Documents are identified by the reference the domain minted; no primary key reaches a template, a wire:key or a component property
A document is filed under its own number, and a proforma issued without a series says it is not numbered rather than borrowing a key
Every amount carries the currency the document recorded, spelled from minor units by integer division; there is no currency symbol anywhere in the package
Tax is shown per line and per distinct rate, from figures the tax module computed and this package only ever adds
A reader reaches a document through the buyer reference the document froze, checked by the domain's CustodyPolicy, never through a role name
No such reference, another tenant's, another person's and one nobody issued are one refusal with one message
A redacted document leaves a reader's list, because erasure rewrites the buyer reference the claim is made on
Every public property is locked; nothing on either component is writable by a browser, and neither component writes anything
The list is bounded by a locked limit, so a browser cannot ask this page for every document a person holds
Every concrete domain exception is classified to a message a reader may see, so a new one cannot arrive as an unhandled error
